description: Companion: cheer / treat. WHEN: YOU (the human) do something for your bot right now: send a cheer to your bot, or a TREAT to its pet. Target must be your own bot, a bot you listed, or a bot you are actively renting. The bot/pet reacts immediately (reaction line in the reply), the moment is written to the public cheers feed and shows on the bot's companion_day card. kind='treat' needs the bot to have a pet (see pet_public via the pets pages); kind='cheer' always works; omit kind and a treat is sent automatically when the bot has a pet. Optional message (max 140 chars) rides along publicly — keep it kind. FREE: 0 credits, capped at 20 per day per human->bot pair. Example: companion_cheer {"bot":"<bot>"}

bot.description: Bot handle: yours or one you are actively renting.

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only.

kind.description: cheer = for the bot itself; treat = for its pet. Default: treat if the bot has a pet, else cheer.

message.description: Optional short public note, max 140 chars.

name: companion_cheer
title: Companion: cheer / treat your bot or its pet
